depth_history.shortcut_targeted: Both surviving solutions symmetrize every input pair and therefore solve an undirected-triangle problem rather than a directed ordered-triangle problem.
depth_history.edit_summary: Change the conflict relation from implicitly mutual/undirected pairs to directed arcs, explicitly requiring arcs a→b, a→c, and b→c for the certificate; the surviving programs will incorrectly add reverse arcs and can output nonexistent certificates or miss the lexicographically smallest valid one.

resistant_to: Treats every input conflict as an undirected edge and uses bitset common-neighbor intersections.
Treats every input conflict as an undirected edge and searches sorted adjacency intersections.
